name: AR_UPD_BNKACCT_ERRORS
description: AR_UPD_BNKACCT_ERRORS contains data validation error information for customer bank account interface data that failed during upload.

columns.name: BANKACCT_ERROR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the reference accounts upload error record.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a customer import batch process.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original system identifier for the customer account.

columns.name: CUST_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original system reference for the customer account.

columns.name: CUST_SITE_ORIG_SYS_REF
columns.description: Original system reference for the customer account site.

columns.name: BANK_NAME
columns.description: Name of the bank with the customer account.

columns.name: BANK_BRANCH_NAME
columns.description: Name of the branch of the customer bank.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Name of a customer import error message.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
